verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes Claude Code's general coding, git, MCP, and automation capabilities but never mentions accepting a sketch, image, or PDF as design input to scaffold or generate an app. The closest reference (claude-code-docs-23) only describes updating an email template from Figma designs shared in Slack, not app generation from visual designs. Missing for 10: any documentation or example of image/PDF/sketch-to-code app generation, multimodal input support in the CLI, or a demonstrated workflow turning a design mockup into a working application.
